free_tier.stated: 30 GB free: '국내 최대 무료 용량 30GB'. MYBOX+ adds 50 GB, 150 GB, 300 GB, 2 TB, 5 TB, 10 TB or 20 TB on top of the base

per_object_cap.stated: 4 GB per file on the free 30 GB plan; maxFileBytes is returned per account and depends on the plan

retention.stated: Dormant after two years without a login, and stored files are deleted

egress.terms: No egress fee documented. The binding limit is the API's 50,000 downloads a day, flat across all plan tiers from 30 GB to 20 TB; the page states the plan tiers share one limit only until 2026-12-31 and limits may differ by plan after that date

tooling: an official MYBOX Open API with personal access tokens against https://open-api.mybox.naver.com/v1, bearer mbx_pat_ tokens with a 30, 60, 90 or 180-day lifetime and at most five per account. No rclone backend
chaining: 30 GB times N Naver IDs, where each needs a real-name-verifiable Naver account.

limits.value: 4 GB per file on the free plan
50,000 API downloads a day, 30 searches a minute and 240 deletes a minute
two years without a login makes the account dormant and deletes the files

identity_cost.detail: a Naver account that passes Korean real-name verification, which is the wall the forum reports agree on

reliability_note: An explicit excess-use clause: bulk calls or excess use get access restricted without notice, and dormant accounts and their tokens fail. The market consolidated and MYBOX is the only Korean free personal drive left

evidence.proved: the API daily limits table gives '50,000회/일' for downloads across 30 GB to 20 TB, and '단시간 대량 호출, 어뷰징 등이 감지될 경우 ... 서비스 이용이 제한될 수 있습니다'
GET /v1/drive/storage with a bearer PAT returns quotaBytes, usedBytes and maxFileBytes
MYBOX 30 GB, '파일 1개당 4GB(무료 30GB 기준)', '2년 이상 미로그인 시 휴면 전환, 저장 파일 삭제'
'네이버 MYBOX 30GB 무료' as the largest domestic free tier
401 with {"code":"PLAT-401","message":"UNAUTHORIZED"}, so the API is live
the MYBOX introduction page still states 30 GB as the free capacity
the identical per-plan API limits are stated as temporary until 2026-12-31, after which they may change by plan
evidence.quote: 26.12.31까지 한시적으로 모든 요금제 한도가 동일하게 적용됩니다.

evidence.proved: downloads are limited to 50,000 per day on every plan from 30 GB to 20 TB

binding_note: The per-file cap is the one that survives even a multiplication of accounts.
notes: The cleanest documented API in the Asian drive set and the smallest quota.
